verdict.rationale: Consuming MCP servers is a fair question for an AI browser-automation agent platform like Skyvern, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only the server role: Skyvern's own MCP server exposing tools to Claude, Cursor and similar clients. Nothing shows Skyvern acting as an MCP client that plugs in external servers, and server-side evidence does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
